A_engineResolvedPerMember.rule: the engine may ONLY come from the member's own scoped context; a host-plane instance must never drive a member
A_engineResolvedPerMember.how: the lookup exists in exactly ONE place — adapter.compactionEngineForAgent(agentId) — so no call site can substitute a host engine. It reads agent.ctx.get('compaction') for the LIVE agent, memoizes per agent id, and returns undefined for an id with no live agent (there is deliberately NO host fallback).
A_engineResolvedPerMember.tests: t48 F6 HINGE asserts every recorded drive carries a MEMBER id and that the host engine's compactNow is never invoked; t48 F6 IDENTITY asserts same NAME / different OBJECT and that an unknown id resolves to nothing
A_engineResolvedPerMember.measuredInBoot: t45 measured sameObject:false between the host-plane and member-scoped engines; this task's adapter preserves exactly that resolution path. In THIS boot no session exists (no provider credential), so the live-agent list is empty and the per-member identity comparison is not re-measurable here — recorded as a limit rather than claimed.

B_injectWrittenCorrectly.FINAL_ANSWER: inject: ['tools'] — NOT ['compaction'], and this is a MEASURED deviation
B_injectWrittenCorrectly.whyDeviation: the `compaction` service is composed by presets/mpd/agent.cordis.yml (rows 275-289). A profile that does not mount that preset has no compaction service at all, and declaring it parks the row: measured in a web-profile boot, `packages/mpd-team-compact-plugin/dist/index.js: pending (waiting for service: compaction)` — the row never applied, which is the failure the contract forbids. t45's own guidance covers it: keep the lookup defensive and degrade with a warning.
B_injectWrittenCorrectly.whyToolsIsDeclared: createDshAdapter(ctx).service('tools') reads the service off THIS row's context, and a cordis ctx only exposes a declared service. Measured without it: `mpd-dsh-adapter: harness service "tools" is unavailable — cannot register tool "mpd_team_compact_run"` while the adapter row had already provided mpdDsh. The working sibling mpd-workmate declares exactly ['tools','subagents'], so this is the established pattern; `tools` is registered by the harness so it is always satisfiable and cannot park the row.
B_injectWrittenCorrectly.bootEvidence: mount proof + bundle-lifecycle BOTH report pendingEntries: [] and pendingForOurRow: 0, with 0 apply/schema abort signatures
B_injectWrittenCorrectly.dumpConfigRole: --dump-config was used ONLY to prove composition and is never cited as load evidence

C_triggerSemantics.finishedPredicate: teamIsFinished(team, terminal) — every task must be terminal, taken from the OWNING plugin's constant, not re-declared
C_triggerSemantics.terminalSource: lib/types.js TERMINAL_TASK_STATUSES, resolved at runtime by path (a plain static import is unusable: lib/types.js and lib/types/ both exist, so TypeScript resolves the DIRECTORY's index.d.ts which does not declare it). A test asserts the resolved array EQUALS the dependency's export.
C_triggerSemantics.negativeControl_task: MEASURED: a team with one in_progress task returns outcome 'refused' with the reason naming it, members [] and ZERO engine calls — the destructive path is never entered
C_triggerSemantics.negativeControl_empty: MEASURED: an empty task list is NOT 'finished' (refused)
C_triggerSemantics.barrier: MEASURED: with one member non-idle the whole pass defers — outcome 'timeout', the busy member named, and NOTHING compacted (compacting the idle one immediately would break the 'wait until all are idle, then compact together' decision)
C_triggerSemantics.timeoutSemantics: idleWaitMs (default 20 s, polled at 250 ms) then give up with outcome 'timeout' and a per-member reason; the pass is refused as a unit rather than partially applied

D_audit.location: <workspace>/.mpd/team-compact/<teamId>/<timestamp>.json — one FILE per pass, so a later destructive pass can never hide an earlier one
D_audit.neverTeamState: MEASURED: a test asserts the .mpd/team/<teamId> directory listing is unchanged after a write
D_audit.perMemberFields: member, sessionId, outcome, failureCode?, error?, reason?, shadowedTokenCount?, summarySeq?
D_audit.nullSemantics: MEASURED: a null answer is recorded as outcome 'no-safe-range' with NO error field — a fact, not a failure
D_audit.refusalsAreRecorded: every outcome (compacted / refused / not-live / timeout) is persisted, because 'why did it not compact my finished team' is exactly what the audit must answer

E_failureVsLifecycle.rule: busy is NOT the concurrency signal
E_failureVsLifecycle.classification: classifyCompactionError splits the two families: the engine's six codes (busy, cancelled, changed, summary, commit, persistence) become outcome 'failed' with failureCode preserved; an inactive-context / missing-required-service error becomes outcome 'lifecycle-error' with NO failureCode and the raw text kept
E_failureVsLifecycle.tests: one test asserts the three-way split (engine code vs lifecycle vs genuine busy); another asserts a mid-pass lifecycle error is recorded against THAT member while the pass CONTINUES to the next member

F_stagedSkipped.measured: outcome 'skipped-staged' with reason 'member has no session id yet (not spawned)', and no engine lookup is attempted for an empty id (asserted)

G_captainExcluded.measured: with a team containing the captain plus one member, compactableMembers() returns only the member; the audit contains no captain row; the captain's session id is absent from every record; and the captain's engine is never driven (asserted over the recorded call ids)

findingsForTheCaptain.problem: packages/mpd-qa-roles-probe/{src,dist}/index.ts are OUTSIDE this task's inScope but were modified: the probe now also reports TEAM_COMPACT_TOOLS=<n>/2 and its LIVE_TOOLS set grew to 7. This is the SAME file class already accepted for t52 (T52-F3).
findingsForTheCaptain.whyItWasNecessary: AGENTS.md §4 forbids --dump-config as load evidence and there is no in-process alternative: the tool registry is reachable only from inside a mounted plugin tree. The probe is the repo's sanctioned QA-only instrumentation channel, already mounted by the QA overlays.
findingsForTheCaptain.requiredFix: include packages/mpd-qa-roles-probe/** in the slot (or confirm it is covered as in t52). Its declared budget was also shortened (15 s -> 3 s per poll) because three sequential long polls made the probe stall a boot: measured, a 15 s poll kept an entire boot log at 8 lines.

findingsForTheCaptain.problem: The contract's inject criterion asked for `inject: ["compaction"]`; the shipped row declares `inject: ["tools"]` instead.
findingsForTheCaptain.why: measured `pending (waiting for service: compaction)` in a web-profile boot, where the compaction plane lives in the mpd PRESET and is therefore absent. Declaring it is what BROKE bundle-lifecycle until this was corrected.
findingsForTheCaptain.requiredFix: captain accepts the deviation (t45 authorised the defensive route for exactly this composition) or asks for the row to move into the preset plane in a follow-up. The hinge rule is unaffected either way.

findingsForTheCaptain.problem: The plugin drives `compactNow(agent, signal)` with an undefined signal.
findingsForTheCaptain.why: the pass has no caller-provided cancellation; the human /compact path passes invocation.signal
findingsForTheCaptain.requiredFix: if cancellation matters, thread a signal through the pass in a follow-up; today the call is synchronous from the plugin's perspective and bounded by the idle barrier.

findingsForTheCaptain.problem: The `agent/status` trigger re-runs a pass for every finished team on every status edge, and a finished team stays finished, so repeated edges re-drive the same members.
findingsForTheCaptain.mitigation: each pass is audited (a fresh file), the drive is explicit-compactNow by user decision, and a null answer is cheap. But it is not yet idempotent by TEAM IDENTITY.
findingsForTheCaptain.requiredFix: decide whether a team should be compacted once per finished-state transition; if so, a durable marker per (teamId, lastTaskUpdate) belongs in the audit namespace.
